subject: ActionButton doesnt work, Need to be able print dataset and need button toreturn to initial dataset

messages.author: e0ebbc321704f022
messages.subject: ActionButton doesnt work, Need to be able print dataset and need button toreturn to initial dataset
parts:
Dear All,

I am very new to shiny so please excuse me.
I need to be able to do couple of things. I created two action buttons within a tabPanel to be able to log transform and normalize data separately as GEO downloaded series matrix files are generally normalized but not log transformed. I did the exact same things on both actionButtons but for some reason they behave oddly: log transform doesnt even seem to work now. I tried couple of things and somehow managed to make log transform work when pressed normalize button so I am lost.

I want to be able to print the head() of the dataset below the boxplot.

And lastly If things go wrong I want user to be able to return to initial downloaded dataset without restarting shiny application. I pressed download button at the left hand side located in sidebarPanel but it didnt work. Maybe I can add the option to be able to press normalize and log transform buttons once only and after disable them since it doesnt make any sense to press them more than once. I am sending the code thanks .

################################### server.R #####################################################
 
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
  # You can access the value of the widget with input$num, e.g.
  output$filterLog <- renderPrint({ input$slider1 })
  output$filterAbs <- renderPrint({ input$slider2 })

 downloadSeriesGEO <- function(){
  GSE <- getGEO(input$number)       # Download direct series matrix file from GEO
  GSEmRNA <- exprs(GSE[[1]])[complete.cases(exprs(GSE[[1]])),]
  boxplot(GSEmRNA)
  return(GSEmRNA)
 }
 downloadRawGEO <- function(){
   GSE <- getGEOSuppFiles(input$number)
   setwd(input$number)
   untar(list.files()[2])      # untar the RAW data in to its contents
   GSEmRNA <- ReadAffy()      # Read and process the CEL files
   GSEmRNA <- rma(GSEmRNA)
   GSEmRNA <- exprs(GSEmRNA)
   GSEmRNA <- GSEmRNA[complete.cases(GSEmRNA),]
   setwd("../")
   boxplot(GSEmRNA)
   return(GSEmRNA)
 }
 normalizeSom <- function(GSEmRNA){
   colnamesSAVE <- colnames(GSEmRNA)
   GSEmRNA <- normalize(GSEmRNA)    # Normalize the dataset using som package of R
   colnames(GSEmRNA) <- colnamesSAVE
   boxplot(GSEmRNA)
   return(GSEmRNA)
 }
 
 todoLogTransformation <- function(GSEmRNA) {
   GSEmRNA <- log(GSEmRNA,2)
   boxplot(GSEmRNA)
   return(GSEmRNA)
 }
 
  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste(input$dataset, '.csv', sep='') },
    content = function(file) {
      write.csv(datasetInput(), file)
    }
   
  )
  output$contents <- renderTable({
   
    # input$file1 will be NULL initially. After the user selects
    # and uploads a file, it will be a data frame with 'name',
    # 'size', 'type', and 'datapath' columns. The 'datapath'
    # column will contain the local filenames where the data can
    # be found.
   
    inFile <- input$file1
   
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
   
    read.table(inFile$datapath, header=input$header, sep=input$sep)
  })
    output$dataBoxplot <- renderPlot({
    input$Gobutton
    if (input$Gobutton== 0) {return()}       
    else if(input$Gobutton== 1){
      if(input$checkGroup== 'Series matrix file'){
          GSEmRNA <<- downloadSeriesGEO()
         }
      if(input$checkGroup== 'Raw data CEL files'){
        GSEmRNA <<- downloadRawGEO()
      }}
    if(input$NormalizeButton ==0){return()}
    else if (input$NormalizeButton ==1){
      GSEmRNA <<- normalizeSom(GSEmRNA)
    }
    if(input$LogTransformButton==0){return()}
    else if(input$LogTransformButton==1){
      GSEmRNA <<- todoLogTransformation(GSEmRNA)
      return(GSEmRNA)
    }
  })
 
})
